title: Fragment three: the war over furs
subtitle: A holo recording, three hundred years old
author: dubbed to tape by Lt. Shepard
extra: One of six. The hardest of them.

lines.text: DUBBED FROM HOLO -- FRAGMENT THREE OF SIX
I only watched this once. You don't have to either.
No chair. He is standing, and he does not sit down.
Three. How she died. I will say it once.
There was a war in that valley. It was about furs.
Beaver pelts. Hats, in cities she would never see.
The people who fought it had never met her.
Most of them had never met each other.
Somebody far away wanted pelts, and so people came.
And the valley emptied, raid by raid, for years.
I could have stopped it. I have told you I could.
I did not. I thought it was not mine to stop.
I had watched a long time. Watching was what I did.
A very long silence. He does not look at the camera.
They came in the morning. I was at the river.
I was a man that day. I was slow. I was too slow.
She was dead before I was back up the hill.
I have never told anyone that I was at the river.
I am telling you, because you are nobody. Forgive me.
The next one is what I did about it.
It is worse. Or it is better. I have never decided.
-- FRAGMENT THREE ENDS --
